voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In nineteen twenty-two, six people were murdered at an isolated farm in Bavaria.
The animals were fed. The bread was eaten. Someone lived in that house, with the bodies in the barn, for four days.
Days before, the farmer said he had found footprints in the snow leading to the house — and none leading away.
It was never solved. A hundred years on, no one knows who was in that house.
The full story is on the channel.
